4c5dbea3ce92cf59.description: About the Role Nestlé KSA is seeking a Field Sales Representative to drive sales within the designated areas of Al Khobar, Dammam, and Al Qassim. This full-time position focuses on building strong customer relationships and achieving both short-term and long-term performance objectives, with a key emphasis on delivering overall value of retail (VOR). Key Responsibilities Ensure coverage of Nestlé items and systematically resolve issues related to out-of-stocks, new item speed distribution, share of shelf, price compliance, and promotion selling. Collaborate with customers to ensure product knowledge through in-person and phone communication. Sell incremental volume for displays and secure maximum support for promoted products. Identify opportunities to sell additional products and collaborate with targeted customers to create and execute business reviews that drive volume. Manage financial resources responsibly and ensure timely payment collection from customers. Ensure compliance with pricing guidelines at the retail level, report competitive price changes and promotional support, and resolve competitive pricing issues. Identify and correct voids, ensuring new items are available, and merchandise products to achieve schematic compliance. Rotate products, handle unsellable products, and resolve systemic problems related to out-of-stocks and voids. Develop and maintain proper relations with department/store level personnel within the area to maximize sales results. Communicate market insights from the retail level to management. Required Skills and Qualifications Excellent customer service and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail. Strong communication (oral and written), selling, and analytical skills. Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office (Excel/Word/Outlook) and other POS systems. Ability to analyze financial, inventory, retail conditions, and other data to utilize appropriate selling techniques. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and meet tight deadlines. Willingness and ability to travel. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position covering the Al Qassim Area. The ideal candidate should reside in the Al Khobar and Dammam Area.

4c6a8585c975062a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صحة المجتمع الطبية عن فني أشعة للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية وإعداد المرضى، بالإضافة إلى تشغيل الأجهزة واستخراج الصور وتقديم التقارير اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة السينية بشكل دوري لضمان جاهزيتها. تأمين ومراقبة مستلزمات التصوير الضرورية مثل الأفلام والأدوية. اتخاذ جميع إجراءات الوقاية الشخصية اللازمة لحماية الموظفين والمرضى. تنظيم مواعيد المرضى لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. مرافقة المرضى إلى غرفة التصوير بالأشعة وتحديد أجزاء الجسم المراد تصويرها. تحديد طبيعة الصورة الشعاعية ومواصفات الأشعة المطلوبة بناءً على طلب الطبيب المعالج. تثبيت ألواح من الرصاص لحماية الأجزاء الجسدية التي يجب ألا تتعرض للأشعة. توجيه وضبط أجهزة التصوير واختيار مدة وشدة التعرض للأشعة بدقة. التقاط الصور الشعاعية وإظهارها وتثبيتها. تثبيت المعلومات الأساسية على الصور الشعاعية وتقديمها لطبيب أخصائي الأشعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصوير بالأشعة. القدرة على تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية. مهارة في إعداد المرضى للتصوير بحسب طلب الطبيب. القدرة على تشغيل أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة واستخراج الصور وطباعتها. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في ينبع، المدينة المنورة، وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول عمل منتظم لتقديم خدمات التصوير بالأشعة بكفاءة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأشعة ضمن بيئة طبية منظمة في شركة صحة المجتمع الطبية، حيث يسهم في تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى من خلال خدمات التصوير التشخيصي. معلومات إضافية لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.

4c5a694603806bfd.description: About the Role Savills is seeking a Senior Project Manager / Resident Engineer to lead a site-based consultancy team in Riyadh. This full-time role is focused on a large-scale, complex development programme. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in project management and site supervision. Role Overview The Senior Project Manager / Resident Engineer will be accountable for the day-to-day supervision, contract administration, and overall programme and quality oversight of the development. This includes ensuring safe and compliant delivery of works through all phases, from testing and commissioning to final handover. The role also involves significant stakeholder coordination. Key Responsibilities Act as the senior site representative and primary interface with the client, contractors, designers, authorities, and other consultants. Lead the mobilisation, site establishment, and deployment of the multidisciplinary supervision team. Administer the construction contract, ensuring compliance with drawings, specifications, approved method statements, ITPs, and contractual requirements. Chair progress, technical, commercial, and coordination meetings, issuing clear minutes and driving actions to closure. Direct inspections, RFIs, shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, NCRs, snagging, and close-out workflows. Monitor programme, resources, interfaces, and critical risks, requiring and assessing recovery plans for any delays. Oversee quality, HSE, and environmental compliance, escalating material breaches and ensuring corrective actions are implemented. Review progress measurement, payment recommendations, variations, claims, and extension-of-time matters in collaboration with planning and cost teams. Coordinate testing, commissioning, authority approvals, completion certification, handover, as-built records, and O&M documentation. Prepare concise weekly and monthly reports covering progress, quality, HSE, commercial matters, decisions, risks, and required client actions. Mentor the site team, allocate responsibilities, maintain discipline, and ensure consistent application of project procedures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management or resident engineering roles. Demonstrated experience in leading site-based consultancy teams for large-scale, complex development programmes. Proven ability in contract administration and ensuring compliance with project specifications. Strong understanding of programme and quality oversight, including testing, commissioning, and handover processes. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

4cd63219d2631659.description: Atheer Connectivity is a Saudi deep-tech company building carrier-grade 60 GHz fixed-wireless infrastructure for high-speed telecom connectivity. We design and manufacture telecom hardware for operator deployments, with products that demand reliable execution from early builds through scaled production. As the business moves from product validation into volume manufacturing, this role will help turn strong engineering into repeatable, high-quality production. This is a hands-on manufacturing role for someone who is comfortable working closely with external partners, solving issues on the line, and keeping hardware programs moving. You will act as a key owner of the manufacturing side of the business, helping bridge design, supply chain, quality, and production so builds stay on track and problems are addressed quickly and thoroughly. Responsibilities Manage contract manufacturers and component suppliers on a day-to-day basis. Drive hardware builds through EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production, with a focus on yield, test coverage, production-line issues, and corrective actions. Execute supply-chain activities including BOM management, lead times, allocations, alternate sourcing, and cost reduction. Oversee quality processes including incoming inspection, failure analysis and RMA investigations, 8D reports, and supplier audits. Coordinate ECN and ECO engineering changes between the design team and manufacturing partners. Support manufacturing test development, RF calibration, and production validation activities, including on-site support for builds and issue resolution at manufacturing partners. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. 5+ years of production or manufacturing engineering experience for RF or wireless hardware, including products such as radios, CPE, mmWave, Wi-Fi, or similar equipment. Experience managing NPI builds spanning EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production. Hands-on knowledge of SMT and PCBA processes, RF calibration and production testing, and basic RF test equipment. Experience with BOM, ECO, and ECN control, along with strong root-cause analysis and 8D problem-solving skills. Experience managing Chinese or Taiwanese EMS partners and component distributors. Hands-on knowledge of outdoor product assembly, including enclosures and IP sealing. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Drive. Willingness and ability to work on-site at manufacturing partners during builds, as well as remotely when required. Experience with supply-chain management, including lead-time planning, component allocation, alternate sourcing, and cost-reduction initiatives. Experience with supplier quality management, including incoming inspections, failure analysis, RMA investigations, supplier audits, and corrective-action processes. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications IPC-A-610 or Six Sigma certification. Mandarin proficiency. Available to start within 1–2 months.

4c03183cc595f28b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح الأنظمة والمعدات الهيدروليكية المستخدمة في معدات الإنشاء والتصنيع والنقل. يهدف شاغل الوظيفة إلى ضمان كفاءة هذه الأنظمة وسلامتها واستمرارية عملها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية فحص وتشخيص وإصلاح الأنظمة والمكونات الهيدروليكية. تركيب الأنظمة والمكونات الهيدروليكية وفقاً للمواصفات الفنية المحددة. استخدام أدوات التشخيص المتخصصة لتحديد الأعطال وتنفيذ الحلول المناسبة. إجراء الصيانة الوقائية بشكل دوري لمنع الأعطال المحتملة وإطالة العمر الافتراضي للمعدات. الالتزام الصارم بمعايير السلامة المهنية أثناء جميع أعمال الصيانة والإصلاح. إدارة مخزون المكونات والأدوات اللازمة لضمان توافرها عند الحاجة. توثيق جميع أعمال الفحص والصيانة والإصلاح، والإبلاغ عن الأعطال المتكررة لضمان التحسين المستمر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية أو الهيدروليكية. القدرة على فهم المخططات الفنية والكتيبات التشغيلية. مهارات جيدة في استخدام أدوات التشخيص والإصلاح. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الصيانة في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

4c3d0001760391c3.job_title: Step Up Your Pastry Career: Junior Pastry Sous Chef

This establishment is recognized for its exceptional food and warm hospitality, aiming to deliver quality in every aspect of its service. Role Overview We are seeking a Junior Pastry Sous Chef to join a kitchen known for its commitment to quality. This full-time position involves supporting the Head Pastry Chef in managing the pastry section, focusing on daily production and maintaining high standards. The role is based in Al Khobar and offers a monthly salary of 7,000 SAR. 4c7fd267c9facf39.description: About the Role ByteDance is seeking a Data Center Facilities Manager to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves managing the planning, construction, and operation of CoLocation Data Center infrastructure projects, ensuring stability and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Team Overview The DataCenter Service / Datacenter Cloud System (DCS) team is an integral part of ByteDance's global technology structure. This team is responsible for building and operating hyper-scale data centers, managing server fleet lifecycles, providing cloud solutions, and developing various infrastructure services to support the company's rapid growth. The focus is on ensuring scalability and reliability of these critical services. Key Responsibilities Participate in the planning and construction of CoLocation Data Center infrastructure projects, tracking progress and facilitating communication. Anticipate operational risks and oversee the testing, acceptance, and takeover of CoLocation Data Center infrastructure projects to ensure smooth delivery. Manage the operation of CoLocation Data Center infrastructure, focusing on stability, optimization, and overall data center management improvement. Own end-to-end change management for all high-risk data center maintenance activities to ensure uninterrupted facility operations. Moderate data center operations, including event reporting, fault tracking, and handling, to enhance service capabilities. Maintain collaborative partnerships with vendors, internal teams, and stakeholders to support seamless facility delivery. Conduct regular audits and performance reviews of CoLocation Data Center providers’ maintenance programs, collaborating to improve facility upkeep effectiveness. Support the DC Operations team as a Subject Matter Expert to understand and manage design limitations and risks. Supervise construction teams during Data Hall fit-outs, coordinating IT services, power system deployment, and cooling infrastructure implementation. Be available outside of normal business hours to respond to communications and coordinate the management of critical, high-priority facility incidents that may impact business operations. Strong understanding of data center operations, including event reporting and fault resolution. Proficiency in managing vendor relationships and internal stakeholder communications. 4ca3f78664ab52b8.description: About SGS SGS is a global leader in Testing, Inspection, and Certification services, operating an extensive network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries. Supported by a team of 99,500 professionals, SGS has maintained over 145 years of service excellence, upholding the precision and accuracy associated with Swiss companies to help organizations achieve high standards of quality, compliance, and sustainability. This role focuses on providing specialized field services for Medium Voltage (MV) Motors and/or Medium Voltage Variable Speed Drive (VSD/VFD) systems. Key Responsibilities Performing installation and commissioning of MV Motors. Conducting testing and startup procedures for MV Motor systems. Executing preventive and corrective maintenance on MV Motors and associated control/protection systems. Troubleshooting and repairing MV Motor systems. 4c26f5e00f2bec9e.description: Job description About Jumeirah Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world. About Jumeirah Jabal Omar Located just minutes from Masjid Al Haram, Jumeirah Jabal Omar Makkah offers a seamless blend of comfort, connectivity, and Arabian hospitality in the heart of the Holy City. Spread across four towers, the hotel features a range of dining venues, retail outlets, a gym, executive lounge and meeting spaces. Guests can enjoy views of the Grand Mosque and a culinary offering that spans Mediterranean, Persian, Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian cuisines. About the Job An opportunity has arisen for Commis 1 for Staff Canteen to join Jumeirah Jabal Omar . The main duties and responsibilities of this role: Take orders from the Chef de Partie and execute them accurately following instructions and recommendations, ensuring tasks are completed as per daily requirements. Gather, measure, mix, and prepare meal ingredients, sauces, and seasonings according to established recipes and specifications. Wash, peel, chop vegetables, fruits, and meats with precision, demonstrating proficiency in cutting and seasoning meats and marinating as required. Execute cooking techniques and plating to exact specifications provided by the Demi Chef | Chef De Partie, ensuring dishes are prepared to high standards. Document inventory of kitchen supplies, monitor stock levels, and notify supervisors of low stock situations to maintain sufficient supplies. Operate kitchen equipment such as braising pans, ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers effectively, ensuring correct settings for cooking and baking temperatures. About You The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications: 1 - 2 years of experience in a range of kitchen areas; ideally within the luxury hospitality industry. College Degree in Culinary Arts or similar from an accredited Culinary School. List the basic (minimum) education, certification, and/or licensing needed to be successful in the position. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. About the Benefits We offer an attractive salary, paid in Saudi Riyals (SAR), the local currency of the KSA. In addition, we offer generous F&B benefits, reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, excellent leave and health care packages, flights home, and other employee benefits making the role attractive to high performers and any applicant looking for a career with one of the most luxurious brands in the hospitality industry. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

4c4922327e0333d2.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking a Senior Microsoft Infrastructure & Exchange Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role is responsible for the health, security, and continuity of the organization's core Microsoft platforms, including Exchange Server 2019 (on-premises) in a hybrid configuration with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and associated identity and email-security layers. The position focuses on maintaining reliable corporate messaging, mailbox availability, and identity services within a multi-site business environment. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 on-premises, including applying cumulative updates and security patches. Maintain Exchange Hybrid with Microsoft 365, managing configuration, free/busy, cross-premises mail flow, and directory synchronization. Execute mailbox migrations between on-premises and Exchange Online with zero data loss and tested rollback plans. Manage mailbox lifecycle, distribution and shared mailboxes, mail flow, transport rules, connectors, and certificate lifecycle. Design, build, and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAG) for Exchange high availability, including failover testing. Perform advanced Active Directory administration, including domain services, sites, trusts, OU design, delegation, and permissions. Design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize Group Policy Objects (GPO). Administer and maintain DNS and DHCP infrastructure services. Manage AD replication health, security hardening, and disaster recovery readiness. Administer enterprise email security solutions, including anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, and content filtering. Manage sender authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and investigate email-borne threats. Apply networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs) to ensure messaging and identity security and reachability. Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Single Sign-On (SSO), coordinating with Information Security. Develop and maintain PowerShell scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, and bulk operations. Provide senior-level escalation support for messaging, identity, and email security incidents. Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and as-built diagrams. Ensure messaging and identity business continuity/disaster recovery plans meet requirements, including periodic testing of DAG failover and AD recovery procedures. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent experience with strong certification is acceptable. For a senior role, 8+ years of experience in enterprise Microsoft infrastructure, with 5+ years hands-on with Exchange Server (2016/2019) on-premises and Exchange hybrid with Microsoft 365 in a mid-to-large, multi-site enterprise environment. This includes experience with a full Exchange migration and DAG deployment. A strong mid-senior Saudi national with 6+ years of experience and depth in Active Directory / Entra ID / Microsoft 365, with a commitment to mastering on-premises Exchange, is encouraged to apply and will be supported through a structured certification ramp. Certifications Strongly preferred: MCSE: Messaging or MCSE: Server Infrastructure (or legacy MCITP: Enterprise Messaging). Preferred: Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate (MS-203); Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-102); Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300); Windows Server Hybrid Administrator (AZ-800/AZ-801). Nice-to-have: Email security vendor certification (Proofpoint / Mimecast / Microsoft Defender for Office 365), a networking certification (CCNA-level), and a security baseline (SC-900 / Security+). Work Arrangement This role is based in Riyadh, with on-site and hybrid working arrangements in line with organizational policy. Standard working hours apply, with flexibility to support business needs. The position involves participation in an on-call rotation for critical messaging, identity, and email security incidents, including outside standard working hours. Major changes are executed within approved maintenance windows, typically outside peak hours, with change-management sign-off. Adherence to information security, data-handling, and privileged-access controls is required. Performance Indicators Maintain high availability of messaging services and prevent outages through timely certificate management and patching. Respond to critical messaging and identity incidents within agreed targets, restore services promptly, and document root causes. Deliver mailbox migration waves on schedule with zero data loss and tested rollbacks. Keep systems patched in line with approved security baselines and remediate critical vulnerabilities within required timeframes. Ensure email security with SPF/DKIM/DMARC at enforcement, measured by reduction in delivered phishing/spam with a controlled false-positive rate. Periodically test business continuity and disaster recovery procedures, documenting successful recovery tests. Maintain current technical runbooks and infrastructure documentation for all owned services.

4cfc90bf426a08ba.description: About The Role Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior SAP Supply Chain and Procurement consultant to own the Source-to-Pay and inventory management workstream on a S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is a broad, senior generalist role — you will be the single specialist covering procurement, supplier management, and core inventory processes across 4 legal entities. You will work primarily offshore, joining the client onsite in Riyadh for key Fit-to-Standard workshops, UAT, and go-live. You'll partner closely with the Finance and Integration workstreams, since procurement processes touch both heavily in this engagement. What You'll Own — Fit-to-Standard workshops covering procurement and inventory processes, translating client requirements into standard S/4HANA Cloud configuration. — End-to-end configuration of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and goods receipt workflows. — Supplier master data setup, purchasing contracts, and supplier evaluation and performance monitoring. — Core inventory and stock management configuration across all 4 legal entities. — The integration design touchpoints between Procurement (MM) and Finance (FI), working closely with the Finance Lead. — Data migration scope for vendor master records and open purchase orders, in coordination with the Data Migration Consultant. — End-user training delivery for procurement and inventory users during the Deploy phase. — 5+ years of SAP MM / Supply Chain consulting experience, with at least one full-cycle implementation as lead consultant. — Hands-on configuration experience in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition procurement processes. — Strong, demonstrable knowledge of the full Source-to-Pay process — from requisition through invoice settlement. — Practical experience with basic warehouse and inventory management configuration. — Comfort working independently across a broad scope, without a large team of specialists to lean on. — Solid understanding of MM-FI integration points: goods receipt, invoice verification, accruals. Preferred — Prior project experience in the KSA market, with familiarity around local procurement and supplier practices. — Exposure to intercompany stock transfer and subcontracting processes. — Working knowledge of Arabic, written or spoken. — Experience in trading, distribution, or bulk commodities client environments.
